observation: Parent read-only review of normal mcp__chatfuel tool metadata and comments-autoreply, automation-settings, reply-to-chats and booking playbooks. Docs/schema only. No account queries or mutations. This date is not the source capture date or build timestamp.

messaging_limits.basis: Official documentation; not an account or delivery test.
messaging_limits.new_contacts: One private DM after a comment; wait for the person's actual reply before continuing.
messaging_limits.existing_contacts: Messaging window is 24 hours after the person's last message.
messaging_limits.substitution_boundary: Combine approved link/coupon and help copy in one response after an actual confirmation reply. No second unsolicited comment DM, fake timer or no-click inference; generic silence followUps do not preserve exact timing.

operations.name: setup_comment_replies
operations.effect: Creates/enables rules and may change Main/base. NOT draft or OFF preparation.

operations.name: update_automation_setting
operations.effect: One explicit setting per call. List settings replace the full list. Does not restore inheritance.

operations.name: test_reply
operations.effect: Saved single-DM sandbox; active plan and Main must already be ON even for an OFF rule. No test call in preparation; not continuing comment dispatch.

gaps: Create-OFF is not exposed by normal tools.
Exact inheritance restoration is not exposed by normal tools.
Continuing multi-turn comment preview is not exposed by normal tools.
GraphQL alternatives in playbooks require an actually available host executor; documentation is not availability.
Full flow-builder graphs remain dashboard-only; these are business analogues, not imported deterministic graphs.
Fixed public and private reply text is documented. Rich buttons, follower conditions and exact timed graph branches are not normal-tool inputs.

comment.label: Comment replies
comment.claim: Scoped post/keyword comments with fixed public and private text; inline URLs can be text. setup_comment_replies enables rules, not drafts.
comment.summary: Scoped post/keyword comments with fixed public and private text; inline URLs can be text. setup_comment_replies enables rules, not drafts.

dm-ai.label: AI conversations
dm-ai.claim: AI replies to incoming messages with instructions; not a deterministic imported graph or an exact-text guarantee for every AI response.
dm-ai.summary: AI replies to incoming messages with instructions; not a deterministic imported graph or an exact-text guarantee for every AI response.

contact.label: Contact collection
contact.claim: Collect and save contact attributes. Not external mailing/SMS subscription or deterministic field-gated branching.
contact.summary: Collect and save contact attributes. Not external mailing/SMS subscription or deterministic field-gated branching.

human.label: Team handoff
human.claim: Configure AI-to-human handoff; not an arbitrary email notification action.
human.summary: Configure AI-to-human handoff; not an arbitrary email notification action.

booking.claim: Native services/specialists, booking autonomy and native booking statuses. Not Calendly, webinar or payment completion.
booking.summary: Native services/specialists, booking autonomy and native booking statuses. Not Calendly, webinar or payment completion.

read-pause.summary: Readback and pause an automation, not Main; test_reply previews DM only. No create-OFF, exact inheritance restoration or continuing comment preview.

buttons.summary: Normal reply inputs expose text modes, not rich buttons, callbacks, quick replies or galleries.

follower.summary: No Instagram follower condition or follow/check/retry gate in normal tool inputs.

click.summary: No URL-click/no-click conditions or click-triggered actions in normal inputs.

graph.summary: Full deterministic flow-builder graphs and arbitrary folder/tag/field branches are dashboard-only, not graph import through normal MCP.

generation.summary: No deterministic flow generation/import tool. Caption/reel listing is not video production or publishing.

public_api_note.claim: Separate Public API exposes additional schema fields. Field presence does not establish exact timers or Story-mention semantics. No account or recipe test; not selected automatically. InstagramContact follow-filter inspection found 0/20; Public/PrivateReply fields remain mode/exactText/messagePrompt plus Facebook Like, not rich buttons or follower gates.

before_writes: Read actual host tools, documented inputs and current account state. Stop before writes when a required lifecycle action is unavailable. Never switch executors after rejection.

contact_attribute_values.claim: Normal MCP has no contact-attribute-value reader. Capture configuration readback and chat text do not prove saved email/phone, joined membership or withdrawal. Keep value-dependent confirmation or handoff unresolved; simple preparation remains available.

normal_tool_contract.review_window_basis: Local seven-day review ceiling, not a provider guarantee. Recheck current declarations before every write.

provenance.scope: Tool declarations and playbooks only; no account or runtime tests.

incomingMessages.scope_rule: DontReply only on comment automations; disable a DM automation to stop it.

switchToHuman.list_semantics: Full replacement; preserve active foreign rules and do not awaken dormant inherited rules.

collectContactInfo.list_semantics: Full replacement. Attribute availability/collision-free creation is not proven by an incomplete namespace; hold unresolved capture writes.

bookingRules.scope_rule: Changes Main booking autonomy globally; never needed merely to share an external URL.

publicReply.scope_rule: Comments only. likeContactComment is Facebook-only, never Instagram.

update_automation_setting.inheritance: Writing breaks inheritance; exact restoration is dashboard-only.

setup_comment_replies.side_effects: Always enables; new custom may turn Main ON and comment base OFF. No normal create-OFF command.

test_reply.gate: Active plan and Main already ON even if tested automation is OFF; no enable or sandbox call during preparation. Not continuing comment preview.

setup_booking.gate: Not used for external booking URLs or without separate approval.

get_chat.limit: Last20 messages/truncated; not complete lifecycle or lead attribution evidence.
